# ImageFrames

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ImageFrames:Int32 image:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image to ask about. |

**Returns:** The number of frames, at least 1.

## Description

Says how many frames an image has: more than one for an image from [CreateImage](CreateImage) with frames, from [LoadAnimImage](LoadAnimImage), or from an animated picture file. Any other image has 1. Choose the frame to draw with the frame argument of [DrawImage](DrawImage).

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals cannot ask this.
